programs.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
programs.desc: Raju comes to Bombay chasing his dreams, but keeps losing out on opportunities. His love, Renu helps him find a job. Success goes to his head until one day a tragic accident destroys his reputation.

programs.title: Dil Ke Peeche Peeche
programs.desc: Lt.Cdr. VANRAJ CHAUHAN (Ashutosh Rana) is india's finest Navel Officer  he is every body's ideal, He is happily married with VIDHYA (Divya Datta) having six-year old Daughter. One day, a girl comes in his life like a storm. He is slowly obsessed with her however this girl SUMAN (Anupama Verma) is his Sister-in-law.

programs.title: Do Jism Ek Jaan Hain Hum
programs.desc: Rano, a beautiful girl, falls in love with Karan, who is an official in the village. They want to get married, but her father refuses.
